Ava S: Heads-up for the night shift — quick pre-oncall gear + runbook ownership check. Can folks confirm VPN, pager access, and runbook owners for their services? I posted a short checklist below.

Ben T: I have VPN + pager ✅. Quick q: do we still need to rotate SSH keys before taking oncall?

Ava S: Not every shift, but confirm your SSH key is in the ops-keyset and that `~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood` is present. If missing run:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood
cat ~/.ssh/id_rsa_redwood.pub | curl -X POST -d @- https://kms.redwood.internal/keys/ops/add
```

Ben T: Got it, will run that now.

Carlos M: I'll own the runbook for search-service tonight. Runbook link: https://wiki.redwood.local/runbooks/search-service — I updated the alerting section for the new indexer.

Ava S: Thanks Carlos — I left a short TODO in the runbook to add the indexer fallback steps.

Dana L: Pager access shows as active for me but I can't see the Grafana dashboards. I get a 403 on `dashboards/redwood-infra`.

Ava S: For Grafana 403, check your SSO group mapping — should be `infra-oncall`. If still blocked, try this quick token refresh: `curl -X POST https://auth.redwood.local/refresh -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN"` then re-login.

Dana L: That fixed it, I can see dashboards now. :thumbsup:

devops-bot: Automated pre-oncall checks completed: VPN=OK, Pager=OK, SSHKey=OK (Ben T), Grafana=OK (Dana L), OpsToolingVersion=1.7.3.

Ava S: Final checklist (copy for your shift notes):
- Confirm VPN and pager (reply here)
- Ensure SSH key present in ops-keyset
- Verify Grafana dashboards load
- Confirm runbook owner for services you cover + quick link in thread
- Confirm access to deploy tools (kubectl, deploybot) and run `kubectl get pods -n infra` once.

Ben T: ran `kubectl get pods -n infra` — all green for me.

Carlos M: Done, runbook ownership confirmed. I'll add indexer rollback snippet later tonight.

Dana L: All set from my side.

Ava S: Sweet — thanks everyone. If anything pops up, ping @oncall in channel and escalate per runbook. Good handoff. :rocket:
